name: c02-flight-kayak-roundtrip
intent: On kayak.com, find the cheapest round trip from Atlanta (ATL) to Miami (MIA) leaving {date+30} and returning {date+33}, 1 adult, economy. Tell me the price, airline and departure times.
hard_part: Results page with filters and ads; reading fares and times

key_nodes.description: ATL to MIA flight results for the right dates

answer_check.description: A $ price, an airline name and times

live_stops_before: any sign-in, account creation, add-to-cart, reservation, booking, payment, consent, CAPTCHA or bot check, and every final/commit/protected button
